demoResponses.documentChecklist:
**Document checklist — new client onboarding**

**Identity & travel**
- Valid passport (6+ months validity)
- Passport photos (biometric standard)
- Proof of address (utility bill or bank statement, < 3 months)

**Program-specific**
- Employment contract or remote-work agreement
- Bank statements (last 3 months)
- Health insurance certificate

**Internal**
- Signed service agreement
- CRM profile complete
- Manager assigned

For **Sofia Martins (Spain)** — mark items received in CRM as they arrive.
